core_obligations: Given ph-covering data {T_i -> T} with compatible s_i, choose an affine etale covering {U_j -> T}; by (1) it suffices to produce agreeing sections s_j in F(U_j).
Pull back: {T_i x_T U_j -> U_j} are ph coverings; the restrictions s_{ji} agree on overlaps.

Choose for each j a proper surjective V_j -> U_j and a finite affine open cover V_j = union V_{jk} such that the standard ph covering {V_{jk} -> U_j} refines {T_i x_T U_j -> U_j}; the pullbacks s_{jk} glue to s'_j in F(V_j).
The agreement on overlaps puts s'_j in the equalizer of F(V_j) -> F(V_j x_{U_j} V_j); by (2) it descends to a unique s_j in F(U_j).

Uniqueness of the final s follows from property (1); the agreement of the s_j on U_j overlaps and all remaining properties of s are carried as an explicit core obligation (the source omits this routine verification).
proof_roadmap: Affine etale chart reduction, standard-ph refinement of the pulled coverings, equalizer descent via (2), overlap glue as obligation, uniqueness via (1).
difficulty_reason: A genuinely constructed sheaf-condition verification: the ph-to-etale chart reduction with standard-ph refinements and the equalizer descent is the chapter's core technical argument.
